title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident female warrior with short purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, gripping a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears a white and purple cropped top with matching armored leg guards, wristbands, and sandals against a solid dark gray background.
prompt: A fierce young woman with short dark purple hair and purple eyes stands in a powerful combat stance, holding a very large ornate purple warhammer with lightning details. She wears a white cropped top with purple patterns, white pants with purple armor straps, matching purple gauntlets and leg armor, and simple sandals. Dynamic three-quarter view, clean comic book style with bold outlines and vibrant colors, solid dark gray background.
